capabilities.description: Searchable actor pages with every film and TV credit, photos and external links.

global_config_schema.title: TMDB
global_config_schema.description: Credits, photos and links come from The Movie Database.

fields.label: TMDB API key
fields.description: The v3 API key or the v4 read access token from themoviedb.org → Settings → API.

global_config_schema.title: Silo connection
global_config_schema.description: An API key from an admin account, used to mark the titles that are in your library.

fields.label: Admin API key
fields.description: Create one under Settings → API keys while signed in as an admin. Starts with sa_.

fields.label: Profile ID
fields.description: Leave empty to use the key owner's primary profile. Use an unrestricted profile so nothing is hidden.

fields.label: Internal API URL override
fields.description: Leave empty; the plugin asks Silo for its own listener.

presentation.summary: Full actor filmographies for Silo, with every film and TV role, full-size photos and links to TMDB, IMDb and Wikipedia.
presentation.description_markdown:
Adds a **Filmography** page to the menu. Search for any actor or crew member to see:

- Every film and TV credit from TMDB, filterable by movies, TV, acting and crew, and sortable by date, popularity, rating or title
- Titles already in your library marked and linked straight to them in Silo
- A full-size headshot and the complete photo gallery in a lightbox
- Links to TMDB, IMDb, Wikipedia, Wikidata, Instagram, X, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and their homepage
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Paste a TMDB API key into **TMDB** (free from themoviedb.org → Settings → API).
2. Paste an admin API key into **Silo connection**.
3. Open **Filmography** in the menu.
